draft.emotion: a groggy, morning state of mind as one transitions to consciousness
notes: Used both for waking up on your own ('Eu acordei cedo') and for waking someone else up ('Acordei o meu irmão'). Unlike in Spanish, it does not take a reflexive pronoun.

senses.definition: To stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping.

examples.text: Eu acordo sempre às sete da manhã.
examples.translation: I always wake up at seven in the morning.
examples.emotion: routine and steady, describing a daily habit

examples.text: Não faça barulho para não acordar o bebê.
